title: Violation Points Tariff and Thresholds — Seller Performance Standing
content:
Under Seller Performance Standing every recorded policy violation carries a fixed number of points by its type, and the seller's active violation points are held against two thresholds. The tariff and thresholds are the same at every level: Below Standard Level, Developing Seller Level, Standard Level, Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level.

## Points recorded per violation type

| Violation type | Points | Suspends selling privileges as soon as recorded |
|---|---|---|
| Listing policy | 2 | no |
| Restricted product | 4 | no |
| Intellectual property | 8 | no |
| Inauthentic complaint | 8 | no |
| Product authenticity | 16 | yes |
| Review manipulation | 16 | yes |

## Thresholds and settings

| Term | Value at every level |
|---|---|
| Warning points threshold — active violation points at or above which the seller is placed at risk | 8 |
| Suspension points threshold — active violation points at or above which selling privileges are suspended | 16 |
| Metric breach warning — whether a metric above the seller's level limit at evaluation places a good-standing seller at risk | yes |
| Point expiry period — calendar days after a violation's event date after which its points expire | 180 |
| Intellectual property violation reversed when the rights owner retracts the complaint | yes |
| Probation after reinstatement — calendar days after reinstatement during which any new violation suspends selling privileges immediately | 90 |

## Reading the thresholds

The thresholds are inclusive: active points of 7 are below the warning threshold and active points of 8 reach it; active points of 15 are below the suspension threshold and 16 reach it.

Hypothetical tallies, using only the tariff above:

| Violations on record | Points | Position against the thresholds |
|---|---|---|
| Three listing policy violations | 6 | below 8 |
| One listing policy and one restricted product violation, plus one intellectual property violation | 14 | at or above 8, below 16 |
| Two intellectual property violations | 16 | at or above 16 |
| One review manipulation violation | 16 | at or above 16; review manipulation also suspends on recording |
